jp: こんな身体じゃ故郷にももう戻れん。幸い身体能力は向上しているから、このまま二人で冒険者としてやっていこうと思っているんだ。
jp_grezzo: "こんな身体じゃ故郷にももう戻れん。幸い身体能力は向上しているから、このまま二人で冒険者としてやっていこうと思っているんだ。"
en: I can't even go back to my hometown with this body. Fortunately, my physical rehabilitation is going well, so I'm thinking that we will be able to continue working together as adventurers.
en_grezzo: "I can't even go back to my hometown with this body. Fortunately, my physical rehabilitation is going well, so I'm thinking that we will be able to continue working together as adventurers."
it: Con un corpo così a casa non ci torno più. Per fortuna il fisico è migliorato, così ho pensato che continueremo a fare gli avventurieri noi due.

jp: お、！レナイが！ついにオレの妹が見つかったんだ！苦労したよ本当に…。見つけた時にはもう身体が異形化しててさ、意識もほぼ無くて襲い掛かってきたんだぜ。
jp_grezzo: "お、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！レナイが！ついにオレの妹が見つかったんだ！苦労したよ本当に…。見つけた時にはもう身体が異形化しててさ、意識もほぼ無くて襲い掛かってきたんだぜ。"
en: Oh, ! At last, I've found my sister, Renai! It was a real struggle... When I found her, her body was already badly deformed and she attacked me with almost no consciousness left.
en_grezzo: "Oh, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! At last, I've found my sister, Renai! It was a real struggle... When I found her, her body was already badly deformed and she attacked me with almost no consciousness left."
contesto: chatMore lang("お、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！レナイが！ついにオレの妹が見つかったんだ！苦労したよ本当に…。見つけた時にはもう身体が異形化しててさ、意識もほぼ無くて襲い掛かってきたんだぜ。", "Oh, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! At last, I've found my sister, Renai! It was a real struggle... When I found her, her body was already badly deformed and she attacked me with almost no consciousness left.")
it: "Oh, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! Renai! Alla fine mia sorella l'ho trovata! Quanta fatica, davvero... Quando l'ho trovata il corpo le si era già deformato, di coscienza non ne aveva quasi più e mi è saltata addosso."

jp: 結論から言うと、ギリギリまで同化されることで神経を接続し、コントロールを菌から乗っ取ることでなんとか奪還できた。二人分同時に制御できるという保証はなかったから、完全にイチかバチかだったけどな。
jp_grezzo: "結論から言うと、ギリギリまで同化されることで神経を接続し、コントロールを菌から乗っ取ることでなんとか奪還できた。二人分同時に制御できるという保証はなかったから、完全にイチかバチかだったけどな。"
en: In the end, I managed to take back control of her from the bacteria by connecting our nerves together, becoming almost completely assimilated by them up to the very last second. There was no guarantee that I would be able to control both of them at the same time, though, so it was a make-or-break situation.
en_grezzo: "In the end, I managed to take back control of her from the bacteria by connecting our nerves together, becoming almost completely assimilated by them up to the very last second. There was no guarantee that I would be able to control both of them at the same time, though, so it was a make-or-break situation."
it: Per farla breve: mi sono fatto assimilare fin quasi in fondo, così ho collegato i nervi e ho strappato il controllo al fungo, e in qualche modo l'ho riportata indietro. Non c'era nessuna garanzia di riuscire a controllarne due insieme, quindi era proprio un tutto o niente.

jp: ああ、オレがメシェーラを制御できるのは薬物と人体改造で神経系を強化されているかららしい。あんたと研究施設に行った時見つけた手帳に、そう書いていた…そうだ、この手帳やるよ。何かの手がかりにと思って持っていたけど、もう必要なさそうだしな。燃やすなり売り払うなり、ザナンの軍部をゆする材料にするなり好きにしてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "ああ、オレがメシェーラを制御できるのは薬物と人体改造で神経系を強化されているかららしい。あんたと研究施設に行った時見つけた手帳に、そう書いていた…そうだ、この手帳やるよ。何かの手がかりにと思って持っていたけど、もう必要なさそうだしな。燃やすなり売り払うなり、ザナンの軍部をゆする材料にするなり好きにしてくれ。"
en: Yeah. I can control Meshera because my nervous system had apparently been enhanced with drugs and bodily modification. That's what it said in the notebook I found when I went to the research facility with you... Oh, and I'll give you that notebook. I kept it in case it would prove useful later, but I don't think I'll need it anymore. You can burn it, sell it off, or use it to blackmail Zanan's military as you see fit.
en_grezzo: "Yeah. I can control Meshera because my nervous system had apparently been enhanced with drugs and bodily modification. That's what it said in the notebook I found when I went to the research facility with you... Oh, and I'll give you that notebook. I kept it in case it would prove useful later, but I don't think I'll need it anymore. You can burn it, sell it off, or use it to blackmail Zanan's military as you see fit."
it: Ah, e se riesco a controllare il Meshera pare sia perché il sistema nervoso me l'hanno rinforzato con farmaci e modifiche al corpo. Stava scritto nel diario che ho trovato quando sono andato all'istituto con te... Ecco, giusto: il diario tienilo tu. L'avevo tenuto perché poteva servire da traccia, ma ormai non mi serve più. Brucialo, vendilo o usalo per ricattare i militari di Zanan: fanne quello che vuoi.

jp: あれからあちこちの地域に行って聞き込みをしているんだけど、今のところ何も手がかりないんだよな。…早く探し出してやらないと。あいつは昔から寂しがり屋なんだ。
jp_grezzo: "あれからあちこちの地域に行って聞き込みをしているんだけど、今のところ何も手がかりないんだよな。…早く探し出してやらないと。あいつは昔から寂しがり屋なんだ。"
en: I've been traveling around the area asking around since last time, but so far I haven't found any leads. ...I've got to find her as soon as possible. She's always been lonely, you know.
en_grezzo: "I've been traveling around the area asking around since last time, but so far I haven't found any leads. ...I've got to find her as soon as possible. She's always been lonely, you know."
it: Da allora sono andato in giro per un po' di posti a chiedere, ma per ora non è saltato fuori niente. ...Devo trovarla in fretta. Lei la solitudine non l'ha mai retta.

jp: １６番独房には内側から破られた形跡があった。レナイはどこかできっと生きている。まだ希望はあるはずだ…。
jp_grezzo: "１６番独房には内側から破られた形跡があった。レナイはどこかできっと生きている。まだ希望はあるはずだ…。"
en: There were signs that cell number 16 had been breached from the inside. Renai must be alive out there, somewhere. There's got to be hope, still...
en_grezzo: "There were signs that cell number 16 had been breached from the inside. Renai must be alive out there, somewhere. There's got to be hope, still..."
it: Nella cella numero 16 c'erano i segni di uno sfondamento dall'interno. Renai è viva da qualche parte, di sicuro. Una speranza c'è ancora...

jp: オレが囚われていたのは１４番独房。妹の隣の部屋だった。すぐ隣にいるっていうのに、オレには根拠のない励ましの言葉をかけるくらいしかできなかった…。
jp_grezzo: "オレが囚われていたのは１４番独房。妹の隣の部屋だった。すぐ隣にいるっていうのに、オレには根拠のない励ましの言葉をかけるくらいしかできなかった…。"
en: I was held in cell number 14. It was the cell next to my sister's. Even though she was right next to me, all I could give her were empty words of encouragement...
en_grezzo: "I was held in cell number 14. It was the cell next to my sister's. Even though she was right next to me, all I could give her were empty words of encouragement..."
it: Io ero rinchiuso nella cella numero 14, accanto a quella di mia sorella. Ce l'avevo a un muro di distanza, e potevo darle solo parole di incoraggiamento senza niente dietro...

jp: 酷い目にあった…殺人的な加速だったな…。道理で冒険者にしか使わせないはずだ、市民なんかが乗ったら負荷で死にかねない。
jp_grezzo: "酷い目にあった…殺人的な加速だったな…。道理で冒険者にしか使わせないはずだ、市民なんかが乗ったら負荷で死にかねない。"
en: Gods, that was terrible... Such acceleration... No wonder adventurers are the only ones allowed to use it. It might kill a normal citizen.
en_grezzo: "Gods, that was terrible... Such acceleration... No wonder adventurers are the only ones allowed to use it. It might kill a normal citizen."
it: Che roba... un'accelerazione da ammazzare... Si capisce perché lo fanno usare solo agli avventurieri: un cittadino qualunque ci lascerebbe la pelle.

jp: …とは言え実験場には着いたな。ここでは旧型メシェーラの生体強化能力に着目した兵器の開発・実験が行われていた。素体にされていたのは人間…オレもその一人だ。
jp_grezzo: "…とは言え実験場には着いたな。ここでは旧型メシェーラの生体強化能力に着目した兵器の開発・実験が行われていた。素体にされていたのは人間…オレもその一人だ。"
en: ...But we did make it. This research institution was studying the organism strengthening effect of Meshera. One \"ingredient\" of their research was humans... and I'm one of them.
en_grezzo: "...But we did make it. This research institution was studying the organism strengthening effect of Meshera. One \"ingredient\" of their research was humans... and I'm one of them."
it: ...Comunque al campo di prova ci siamo arrivati. Qui sviluppavano e provavano armi basate sul potenziamento biologico del Meshera di vecchio tipo. E come materiale di partenza usavano uomini... io sono uno di quelli.

jp: オレは体内のメシェーラを制御するための改造手術が終了した後に隙を見て逃げ出せたんだが、最奥の１６番独房にはオレの妹の『レナイ』がまだ囚われているはずだ。…逃げるのに必死で、まさか迎えに来るのがこんなに遅れるとはな。
jp_grezzo: "オレは体内のメシェーラを制御するための改造手術が終了した後に隙を見て逃げ出せたんだが、最奥の１６番独房にはオレの妹の『レナイ』がまだ囚われているはずだ。…逃げるのに必死で、まさか迎えに来るのがこんなに遅れるとはな。"
en: After my the operation to control the Meshera within my body, I found a chance to escape and took it. My younger sister, Renai, should still be here within cell 16... I was so frantic while trying to escape that I didn't think to save her. I hope we're not too late.
en_grezzo: "After my the operation to control the Meshera within my body, I found a chance to escape and took it. My younger sister, Renai, should still be here within cell 16... I was so frantic while trying to escape that I didn't think to save her. I hope we're not too late."
it: Io me la sono svignata appena ho visto uno spiraglio, finita l'operazione per controllare il Meshera che ho in corpo; ma in fondo, nella cella numero 16, mia sorella, \"Renai\", dovrebbe essere ancora prigioniera. ...Ero così preso dalla fuga che a venirla a prendere ci ho messo tutto questo tempo.

jp: 軍がさじを投げたほどの状況では望みが薄いが…オレのように適合している可能性もある。他の連中もだ。もし適合できずに苦しんでいたのなら…その時は、楽にしてやりたい。
jp_grezzo: "軍がさじを投げたほどの状況では望みが薄いが…オレのように適合している可能性もある。他の連中もだ。もし適合できずに苦しんでいたのなら…その時は、楽にしてやりたい。"
en: If the army has given up on this place then the chances are slim, but... There's a chance she may have been able to adapt, just like me.
en_grezzo: "If the army has given up on this place then the chances are slim, but... There's a chance she may have been able to adapt, just like me."
it: Con una situazione da cui perfino l'esercito si è tirato indietro le speranze sono poche, ma... può darsi che si sia adattata come me. Vale anche per gli altri. E se invece non si fossero adattati e stessero soffrendo... allora voglio dar loro pace.

jp: 撤退のタイミングはあんたに任せる。またアレに乗ることになるけど、それはもう仕方ない。後は…ん？
jp_grezzo: "撤退のタイミングはあんたに任せる。またアレに乗ることになるけど、それはもう仕方ない。後は…ん？"
en: I'll leave deciding when to leave to you. I don't really want to ride that thing again, but I suppose there's no other choice. Afterwards... Hmm?
en_grezzo: "I'll leave deciding when to leave to you. I don't really want to ride that thing again, but I suppose there's no other choice. Afterwards... Hmm?"
it: Quando ripiegare lo decidi tu. Toccherà rimontare su quel coso, ma pazienza. Poi... eh?

jp: …厄介だな。被験者の動きを止めるための強力な神経ガスが散布されているみたいだ。大方、研究員が収容区画に撒いたんだろうが、入口付近にまで漏れてきているとは。注意したほうがいいだろう。
jp_grezzo: "…厄介だな。被験者の動きを止めるための強力な神経ガスが散布されているみたいだ。大方、研究員が収容区画に撒いたんだろうが、入口付近にまで漏れてきているとは。注意したほうがいいだろう。"
en: ...This isn't good. It looks like they released some sort of nerve gas to try to immobilize the test subjects. I expect most of it was released near the subjects themselves, but it appears that some has leaked even near the entrance. Be careful.
en_grezzo: "...This isn't good. It looks like they released some sort of nerve gas to try to immobilize the test subjects. I expect most of it was released near the subjects themselves, but it appears that some has leaked even near the entrance. Be careful."
it: ...Brutta faccenda. Pare che abbiano sparso un gas nervino potente per bloccare i soggetti. Probabile che i ricercatori l'abbiano diffuso nel settore di detenzione, ma che sia arrivato fin qui all'ingresso... Meglio stare attenti.

jp: あんたがだな。オレがエユルだ。よろしくな。
jp_grezzo: "あんたが" + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "だな。オレがエユルだ。よろしくな。"
en: You must be  . I'm Regulus. Nice to meet you.
en_grezzo: "You must be " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". I'm Regulus. Nice to meet you."
contesto: chatMore lang("あんたが" + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "だな。オレがエユルだ。よろしくな。", "You must be " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". I'm Regulus. Nice to meet you.")
it: "Tu sei " + cdatan(CDATAN_AKA, CHARA_PLAYER) + " " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", giusto. Io sono Regulus. Piacere."

jp: 渡された資料を読んだんだが、神から借りてきた核駆動の超音速の乗り物であっと言う間に目的地まで移動できるらしい。なんだか凄そうだな。
jp_grezzo: "渡された資料を読んだんだが、神から借りてきた核駆動の超音速の乗り物であっと言う間に目的地まで移動できるらしい。なんだか凄そうだな。"
en: I'm not sure if you've read the materials you were given, but it sounds like we're going to use some kind of vehicle borrowed from the gods to get to our destination in the blink of an eye. Pretty exciting.
en_grezzo: "I'm not sure if you've read the materials you were given, but it sounds like we're going to use some kind of vehicle borrowed from the gods to get to our destination in the blink of an eye. Pretty exciting."
it: Ho letto i documenti che mi hanno dato: pare che ci muoveremo con un veicolo supersonico a propulsione nucleare preso in prestito dagli dei, e che saremo a destinazione in un attimo. Sembra una cosa grossa.

jp: そろそろ出発しようか？
またアレに乗らなきゃいけないのか…。
jp_grezzo: "またアレに乗らなきゃいけないのか…。"
en: We've got to get on that thing again don't we...
en_grezzo: "We've got to get on that thing again don't we..."

jp: オーケー。ここで待ってるからな。
jp_grezzo: "オーケー。ここで待ってるからな。"
en: Okay. I'll be here when you're ready.
en_grezzo: "Okay. I'll be here when you're ready."
